title: 第17章 同心线
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃和楼沉月走后没多久，夜弦找到了山洞处来。

    先前在龙衔宝楼被和铃羞辱了一番，他本打算和程芰荷一块回去了，结果驻守南华城的宗门长老下令封了城。

    夜弦意识到城中肯定发生了什么。

    于是去找了驻守南华城的宗门长老，得知了和铃失踪的事情。

    他凭借着元婴亲传的身份，顺利出城。

    但没有回南华宗，而是自己先行一步，自发来寻找和铃的下落了。

    “不管怎么说，和铃好歹也是我的同宗师妹，这些年对我确实痴情不假，我不能放任她被邪魔外教的人掳走。”

    更何况，他要是救回了和铃，明瑟真君哪怕对他再不喜，也会备上厚重的谢礼。

    众人只知元婴真君的弟子风光无限，却不知内里艰辛。

    他的师父微尘子是个贪的，年年都要弟子孝敬，他身上的钱财早就被榨得所剩无多，修行一事颇费钱财，他不得想办法多赚点灵石吗？

    夜弦看着眼前灵力所化的蝴蝶，感慨道：“没想到当年和铃硬从我身上要走了玲珑珠，到关键时刻还能有这作用，如若不是玲珑珠的指引，还真不一定能找到这么偏僻的地方来呢。”

    灵蝶在石壁前停了下来，来回打转。

    夜弦拇指推剑而出，“轰隆”一声，劈开了石壁。

    ......

    剑竹海深处，小竹楼中。

    浮动的轻纱中传来暧昧的闷哼声，点漆羞得捂住了耳朵，跑出屋子。

    它一头撞在楼沉月的腿上，往后跌跌跄跄了几步。

    楼沉月黑着一张脸问道：“她又开始了？”

    奇怪，红烟萝的花毒不该这么强才对。

    难道是禁灵散中的什么药材属性和红烟萝相冲了？

    他也不是丹师，搞不明白这些。

    点漆捂着脸点点头，指了指外面，表示它不要守在屋子里面了。

    楼沉月道：“正好，我刚到外面去接收了明瑟真君传来的消息，她同意拿太清玉液换人，你去把太清玉液取回来吧。”

    “届时老地方会合。”

    和铃竖起耳朵听着，微微皱眉。

    这魔头让点漆去取太清玉液？点漆什么修为，他不怕师尊一剑枭了点漆的脑袋吗？

    点漆“吱”了一声，瞬间消失无影。
content_en:
Not long after He Ling and Lou Chenyue left, Ye Xian found the cave.

He had been humiliated by He Ling at Longzianbao Tower earlier. He planned to go back with Cheng Qianhe, but the sect elders stationed in Nanhua City ordered the city to be sealed.

Ye Xian realized that something must have happened in the city.

So he went to find the sect elders stationed in Nanhua City and learned about He Ling's disappearance.

He successfully left the city by virtue of his status as a direct descendant of Yuanying.

But instead of returning to Nanhua Sect, he took the first step and spontaneously searched for He Ling's whereabouts.

"Anyway, He Ling is also my junior sister from the same sect. She has really been infatuated with me these years. I can't let her be kidnapped by the evil foreign teacher."

What's more, if he rescues He Ling, Lord Mingse will prepare a generous thank you gift even if he is not happy with him.

Everyone only knows that the disciples of True Monarch Yuanying have great glory, but they don’t know the hardships inside.

His master, Wei Chenzi, was greedy and demanded filial piety from his disciples every year. All his money had been squeezed out of him long ago. Cultivation was very expensive, so he had to find a way to earn more spiritual stones?

Ye Xian looked at the butterfly transformed by spiritual power in front of him and said with emotion: "I didn't expect that Linglong Bead, which he and Ling Jian took away from me, would be able to have this effect at the critical moment. If it weren't for Linglong Bead's guidance, I might not have been able to find such a remote place."

Psylocke stopped in front of the stone wall, spinning back and forth.

Ye Xian pushed the sword out with his thumb, and split the stone wall with a "bang" sound.

...

Deep in the Jianzhu Sea, in the small bamboo building.

An ambiguous humming sound came from the floating gauze, and Dian Qi covered her ears in shame and ran out of the house.

It bumped into Lou Chenyue's leg and stumbled back a few steps.

Lou Chenyue asked with a dark face: "She started again?"

Strange, the poison of red tobacco shouldn't be so strong.

Could it be that the properties of some medicinal materials in Forbidden Spirit Powder conflict with those of red tobacco?

He is not an alchemist and cannot understand this.

Dianqi covered his face and nodded, pointing outside to indicate that it would no longer stay inside the house.

Lou Chenyue said: "Just in time, I just went outside to receive the news from Zhenjun Mingse. She agreed to exchange Taiqing Jade Liquid for someone else. You go and get Taiqing Jade Liquid back."

"We'll meet up at the same place then."

He Ling pricked up his ears and listened, frowning slightly.

This devil asked Dianqi to get the Taiqing Jade Liquid?What kind of cultivation is Dianqi? Isn't he afraid that his master will hit Dianqi's head with a sword?

The paint squeaked and disappeared instantly.
